```{r setup}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
```





<!-- comment or do not run this if using Rstudio (ask Eve for explanation) -->
```{r params for vscode}
# Only when using VScode (explain)
params <- list()
params$pjs_df <- "data/path.xlsx"
params$pjs_sheet <- "Cleaned_data" 
params$vigas_df <- "data/path.xlsx"
params$source_code <- 'code/R'

params$source_code
here::here(params$source_code)
```


```{r source reused functions}
fun_files_path <- list.files(
  here::here(params$source_code), 
  pattern = "*.R", 
  full.names = TRUE
  )
# sourcing all the functions 
sapply(fun_files_path,source,.GlobalEnv)
```


```{r merge files from VIGAS and PJS}
#Solveig trying to merge files from VIGAS and metadata from PJS:
VIGAS_data <- read_xlsx("data/2025-3-27-APEC_all-All_Fields.xlsx")%>%
  mutate(Year = substr(Sample,1,4))%>%
  filter(Year !="2015")%>%
  filter(Year !="2025")
#removed samples from 2015 and 2025, which should not be included in this study.
PJS_data <- read_xlsx("data/Uttrekk_PJS_280325_SSM.xlsx") 
#797 samples to be included in this APEC study. Merge file from VIGAS with file from PJS:
APEC_all_merged <- VIGAS_data %>%
  dplyr::left_join(PJS_data, by = c("Sample"="ID"))
#APEC_all_merged includes data for the 797 included samples.
```
